worker: An advertising budget, a computer and internet access. The description also mentions a commission for the marketing team, without explaining who pays it or how it is calculated.
support: Email, CRM and proposal software; company teams manage campaigns and creative work.
unknown: Required ad budget, reimbursement terms and the marketing commission rate are not specified.
evidence: all new leads are generated through your ad spend budget.
interpretation: This is the clearest cash-expense disclosure among the selected examples. It identifies the representative's advertising budget but gives no dollar amount.

worker: Generate a personal pipeline through referrals, networking, door-to-door outreach and other sales methods. The role is advertised as 1099 and commission-only.
support: Supplemental company leads may become available after consistent production and self-generated sales milestones.
unknown: The milestone threshold is not given. Self-generation does not establish a requirement to buy leads or advertising.
evidence: Successful representatives who demonstrate consistent sales production and reach self-generated sales milestones may receive access to supplemental company-provided leads to support continued growth.
interpretation: Company leads are described as conditional support, not something a new representative can assume will be supplied from day one.

worker: Generate leads through door-to-door work, referrals, networking and community contacts. Reliable transportation is required; compensation is advertised as commission-only.
support: An installation team is described. The listing emphasizes the representative's own prospecting.
unknown: No advertising purchase or lead fee is stated. Reliable transportation does not necessarily mean owning a vehicle.
evidence: Prospect and generate your own leads across the Antelope Valley
interpretation: This is a prospecting obligation. The wording alone cannot tell us whether the representative will spend money acquiring customers.

worker: Generate leads in a commission-only independent contractor role. The listing explicitly rules out a base salary, draws and guaranteed income.
support: Powur training and a platform for project operations and virtual outreach are described.
unknown: No required advertising expense or purchased-lead fee is stated. Training and platform charges, if any, cannot be established from the description.
evidence: There is no base salary, no draws, and no guarantees
You will need to generate your own leads.
interpretation: A lack of guaranteed income matters when assessing the offer, but it is not evidence of a mandatory business expense. SalesDraft is the recruiting advertiser; the description names Powur.

worker: A valid driver's license and own transportation are required.
support: Company leads, no door-knocking requirement and paid training as necessary are advertised for the independent contractor sales role.
unknown: Mileage reimbursement and transportation costs are not specified. Owning transportation does not prove an unreimbursed expense.
evidence: leads are provided for you; no door-knocking required
valid drivers license and own transportation
interpretation: An offer can require a personal resource while supplying customer leads. These are separate terms of the arrangement.

category: Commission pay with an explicit floor
worker: Develop personal leads alongside company-provided opportunities. Commissions are paid at booking, installation and final utility approval.
support: Company leads, training and back-office support. The W-2 listing explicitly guarantees an applicable NYC minimum-wage floor for hours worked when commissions fall short.
unknown: No requirement to buy advertising or leads is stated. The description does not establish an individual worker's earnings or expenses.
evidence: Generate and develop your own leads while working company-provided opportunities
Brooklyn SolarWorks guarantees you'll always earn at least the applicable New York City minimum wage for all hours worked in any week where commissions fall short.
interpretation: The same description uses a commission-only label and spells out a pay floor. Treating every commission-only listing as offering zero guaranteed pay would misread this offer.
